method: Built-in imagegen, raster concept boards with soft 3D supporting artwork
status: Static proposals awaiting user selection; no application code changed
sampleData: Shrimp ramen photo and two cooks / two portions are illustrative. Implementation reuses the saved idea image.

behavior.instructions: Return to completed instructions for viewing without restarting the room

notes: Generated navigation details and font approximations are not proposed product changes. Retain the existing brand header and real Oswald / Golos Text fonts during implementation.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity concept board for the Ukrainian web app "Готуємо разом" completion screen after friends finish cooking. This is a screen design proposal, not an implemented screenshot. Landscape board about 1536x1024, containing ONE laptop viewport on the left, ONE tall mobile viewport on the right showing the SAME design adapted to 390 CSS pixels. No physical devices or perspective, flat crisp UI captures on a neutral light-gray board with small A/B/C concept label outside the viewports. All controls legible, exact Ukrainian text.
Brand must match: cream #f3eee4 page, ink #16191d text, white surfaces, teal #3ec1be status, ONLY ONE magenta #e5127f chrome-edged title sign per viewport, ONE lime #c8e63c primary button, blue only a very thin neon rule beneath a black-white checker band at top. Type condensed Oswald bold for headings and Golos Text for body. Sentence case, never all caps. Primary buttons 50px high, dark 2px outlines, rounded 12px; white secondary buttons dark outlines. No floating shadow cards, no gradients except subtle chrome title trim.
Top brand "Готуємо разом". Title "Смачного!". Dish label "Рамьон з креветками без грибів". Supporting small factual text "2 кухарі · 2 порції". One LARGE rectangular 16:10 food photograph of a cream bowl of shrimp ramen, noodles, halved soft boiled egg, scallions, no mushrooms. This photo represents the existing saved idea image, a separate photo panel, never a 3D model of the food. The same sample dish must be used in laptop/mobile views. Main lime action "Приготувати ще раз". Secondary outline action with a small left arrow "До інструкцій". No sharing, ratings, XP, badges, elapsed time, dashboard stats, recipe list, shopping, download, or invented features. Show a few small teal, lime, cream confetti pieces near top outer edges to suggest a short entry burst, never obscure text or food. Clear task completion, warm and appetizing. Mobile everything visible comfortably with 20px gutters and no clipped buttons.
Concept A, label outside viewport "A · Фото в центрі". Clean photo-led editorial composition. Desktop content max width 1000: small magenta Смачного sign above a horizontal two-column layout, big 16:10 ramen photograph on left about 60% width in a restrained 3px chrome frame radius 22px; large dark dish name, small factual line, and stacked full-width actions right. A tiny tactile teal and cream pair of oven mitts near the success sign, 64px size only, rounded soft 3D elevated orthographic studio lighting. Mobile: centered sign, 24px gap, large landscape photo, left aligned dish name on two lines, factual line, both full-width actions stacked. Generous but purposeful space. Photo is the unmistakable hero.
